fields.title: Family Matters
fields.description: Geralt investigates the Bloody Baron's missing wife and daughter, uncovering one of the game's most emotional and morally complex stories.

fields.title: The Last Wish
fields.description: Geralt and Yennefer hunt down a mysterious djinn in a heartfelt quest that explores their complicated relationship and destiny.

fields.title: Carnal Sins
fields.description: Geralt investigates a series of brutal murders in Novigrad, solving a dark mystery filled with suspense and difficult choices.

fields.title: Ranni the Witch
fields.description: One of Elden Ring's longest and most beloved questlines, leading players through hidden regions while uncovering Ranni's fate.

fields.title: Millicent
fields.description: A touching journey following Millicent's struggle against the Scarlet Rot, culminating in one of the game's most memorable endings.

fields.title: Fia, Deathbed Companion
fields.description: Assist Fia in restoring the Prince of Death while discovering hidden lore surrounding Those Who Live in Death.

fields.title: The Magic Chisel
fields.description: Kratos and Atreus seek a legendary chisel capable of opening hidden pathways, advancing one of the game's central adventures.

fields.title: The Journey Home
fields.description: The emotional finale of Kratos and Atreus' journey reveals shocking truths while delivering an unforgettable conclusion.

fields.title: The Valkyries
fields.description: Free the imprisoned Valkyries across the realms before facing Queen Sigrun in the game's toughest optional challenge.

fields.title: The Hunt
fields.description: V tracks down Evelyn Parker after the disastrous Konpeki Plaza heist, uncovering a grim conspiracy in Night City.

fields.title: Pyramid Song
fields.description: Join Judy Alvarez on a deeply personal underwater dive that explores loss, hope, and the future of Night City.

fields.title: Sinnerman
fields.description: A routine contract turns into one of Cyberpunk 2077's most controversial quests, exploring faith, guilt, and redemption.

fields.title: Save the Refugees
fields.description: Help desperate tiefling refugees escape the dangers of the Emerald Grove through diplomacy, combat, and difficult choices.

fields.title: Find the Nightsong
fields.description: A massive quest spanning multiple acts that shapes the fate of Shadowheart and influences the story's major outcomes.

fields.title: Rescue Duke Ravengard
fields.description: Infiltrate the Iron Throne prison to save prisoners before the facility collapses in one of the game's most intense missions.

fields.title: A Quiet Time
fields.description: Arthur and Lenny spend an unforgettable evening in Valentine, creating one of Red Dead Redemption 2's funniest missions.

fields.title: Red Dead Redemption
fields.description: Arthur's final mission delivers a powerful conclusion to his character arc with emotional choices and lasting consequences.

fields.title: American Venom
fields.description: John Marston hunts Micah Bell in the snowy mountains, bringing the Van der Linde gang's story to a satisfying close.

fields.title: The White Lady
fields.description: Help the spirit of Marissa find peace by gathering her lost belongings throughout the Forgotten Crossroads.

fields.title: The Grimm Troupe
fields.description: Summon the mysterious Grimm Troupe and complete a challenging questline featuring memorable bosses and beautiful music.

fields.title: The Delicate Flower
fields.description: Escort a fragile flower across Hallownest without taking damage in one of the game's most rewarding optional challenges.

fields.title: Siegward of Catarina
fields.description: Aid the cheerful knight throughout Lothric, culminating in his emotional confrontation with his old friend Yhorm.

fields.title: Anri of Astora
fields.description: Follow Anri's tragic journey across the kingdom while influencing one of Dark Souls III's secret endings.

fields.title: Greirat of the Undead Settlement
fields.description: Support Greirat's dangerous scavenging expeditions and determine whether the beloved thief survives his adventures.

fields.title: The Big Score
fields.description: Michael, Franklin, and Trevor plan the largest robbery in Los Santos, choosing between different approaches and outcomes.

fields.title: Three's Company
fields.description: The three protagonists work together for the first time during a daring rescue mission involving helicopters and snipers.

fields.title: The Third Way
fields.description: Franklin rejects impossible choices and unites the trio for the game's most satisfying and widely preferred ending.

fields.title: Orpheus
fields.description: Help the legendary musician reunite with Eurydice through a touching story inspired by Greek mythology.

fields.title: Achilles
fields.description: Strengthen Zagreus' bond with Achilles while uncovering his past and helping him reunite with Patroclus.

fields.title: Dusa
fields.description: Develop a heartfelt friendship with Dusa through repeated conversations and gifts, revealing one of Hades' sweetest stories.
